title: precheck warns of each committed item's file that another live session or sprint also plans, until an order settles it
goal: `backlog.py precheck SP` warns, for each committed item whose touches share a file other than a `kb/_self` doc with another live session's intent or another active or planned sprint's item, naming the item, the file and the other work as undecided; a `depends_on` between the two items or a `coordinate` event between them settles it and the warning goes

run:
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: the planted live session needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
base_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in ("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID", "KB_COORD_URL")}
base_env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=S, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=os.path.join(T, "cfg"), COLUMNS="200")
A, B = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
envA = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=A)
envB = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=B)
def sh(*a, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, env=env or base_env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"); K = os.path.join(T, "clone")
sh("git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O)
sh("git", "clone", "-q", O, K)
for k, v in (("user.email", "a@example.com"), ("user.name", "n")):
    sh("git", "config", k, v, cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_tools")); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "reports"))
for p in ("_tools/kbtail.py", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "_tools/bench_load.py", "_tools/zz.py", "_tools/only_intent.py", "kb/_self/tools.md", "kb/_self/map.csv"):
    with open(os.path.join(K, p), "w") as f:
        f.write("planted\n")
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "base", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
def bl(*a, env=None):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "--root", K, *a, cwd=K, env=env)
def new_id(r):
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:ST|SP)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b", r.stdout)
    if not m:
        print("check broken: backlog.py new printed no id:", r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-300:]); sys.exit(2)
    return m.group(0)
# Session B: the session-load benchmark, a planned sprint pushed to main and a live intent (today's replay)
SPb = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "One session's host cost, measured without a model", "--goal", "bench", env=envB))
ITb = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "A no-model session-load benchmark replays one session's hooks", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/bench_load.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md", "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", "--sprint", SPb, env=envB))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "plan session-load", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
co = lambda *a, env=None: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, *a, env=env)
co("claim", "session/" + B, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", B)
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "topic=session-load-benchmark",
   "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py,kb/_self/tools.md,kb/_self/map.csv")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook", B + ".json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 3600, "token": "t"}, f)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procB = subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "300"], cwd=K)
# Session A: this session's plan, the live agent view's second slice (shares map.csv and the tools.md doc with B)
co("claim", "session/" + A, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", A)
SPa = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Live agent view, second slice", "--goal", "view", env=envA))
ITa = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "kbtail.py follows every live session", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/kbtail.py", "--touch", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md",
                "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", env=envA))
# A planned sprint of no live session, pushed to main, whose item touches _tools/zz.py
SPz = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Unrelated planned sprint", "--goal", "z", env=envB))
ITz = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "z edits zz", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "_tools/zz.py", "--sprint", SPz, env=envB))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "plan z", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
# B's live intents: one on its item (bench_load.py), one with a file no sprint item holds
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "item=" + ITb, "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py")
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "topic=side-work", "--field", "touch=_tools/only_intent.py")
ITc = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "c edits only the tools doc", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md", env=envA))
ITe = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "e edits zz", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "_tools/zz.py", env=envA))
ITf = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "f edits only_intent", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "_tools/only_intent.py", env=envA))
ITg = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "g edits bench_load", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "_tools/bench_load.py", env=envA))
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + A, "--field", "item=" + ITg, "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py")
def cleanup():
    procB.kill()
problems = []
def need(c, w):
    if not c: problems.append(w)
def lines():
    r = bl("precheck", SPa, env=envA)
    return [x for x in (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines() if not x.startswith("    ")]
try:
    bl("set", ITa, ITc, ITe, ITf, ITg, "--sprint", SPa, env=envA)
    L = lines()
    warn = lambda it, f: [x for x in L if it in x and f in x]
    need(any((ITb in x or "session-load-benchmark" in x) and "undecided" in x for x in warn(ITa, "kb/_self/map.csv")),
         "precheck does not warn that ITa's kb/_self/map.csv meets the other session's work as undecided: %s" % warn(ITa, "kb/_self/map.csv"))
    need(not warn(ITc, "kb/_self/tools.md"), "precheck warns of a shared kb/_self doc: %s" % warn(ITc, "kb/_self/tools.md"))
    need(any(ITz in x or SPz in x for x in warn(ITe, "_tools/zz.py")), "precheck does not warn of a file another planned sprint's item plans: %s" % warn(ITe, "_tools/zz.py"))
    need(warn(ITf, "_tools/only_intent.py"), "precheck does not warn of a file only another live session's intent names")
    need(warn(ITg, "_tools/bench_load.py"), "precheck does not warn of ITg's bench_load.py before the coordinate event")
    bl("set", ITa, "--add-depends", ITb, env=envA)
    k = sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbask.py"), "coordinate", ITg, ITb, "after", "--session", A, cwd=K, env=envA)
    need(k.returncode == 0, "check broken: the coordinate event was refused: %s" % (k.stdout + k.stderr)[-300:])
    L = lines()
    warn = lambda it, f: [x for x in L if it in x and f in x]
    need(not warn(ITa, "kb/_self/map.csv"), "precheck still warns of ITa's map.csv after depends_on orders it: %s" % warn(ITa, "kb/_self/map.csv"))
    need(not warn(ITg, "_tools/bench_load.py"), "precheck still warns of ITg's bench_load.py after a coordinate event settles it: %s" % warn(ITg, "_tools/bench_load.py"))
finally:
    cleanup()
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(2 if any(p.startswith("check broken") for p in problems) else (1 if problems else 0))

clauses.clause: `backlog.py precheck SP` warns, for each committed item whose touches share a file other than a `kb/_self` doc with another live session's intent or another active or planned sprint's item, naming the item, the file and the other work as undecided
a `depends_on` between the two items or a `coordinate` event between them settles it and the warning goes

gates.question: Does precheck's peer-overlap warning include the held claims (doing items of the integration main) beside live sessions' plans and other sprints' items?
gates.reason: the goal names sessions and sprints, and a live session already shows through its intent

gates.question: What may the other side of a coordinate event be to settle a warning about an item-less peer session (an intent with a topic and no item)?
options: the peer's topic or its session label
only an item id, so an item-less peer cannot be settled
gates.recommendation: the peer's topic or its session label
gates.reason: kbask.py coordinate already accepts any id as OTHER, and a label is what every tool shows
gates.answer: the peer's topic or its session label

notes: Seen 2026-10-26: an overlap with a session whose intent has a topic but no item (the session-load benchmark topic intent) cannot be settled by kbask.py coordinate, which needs the other side item, so kbmon keeps it under needs-you as undecided. The settling rule here (a depends_on or a coordinate event) needs a form for an item-less peer: a coordinate naming the other session, or the peer topic. Plan check 2026-10-26: the check now plants one case per condition: a file shared with a live session and a planned sprint (warned as undecided), a shared kb/_self doc (no warning), a file only another planned sprint item plans, a file only another live session intent names, then a depends_on and a kbask.py coordinate event that each settle one warning. On the base precheck warns of none of them (premise reproduced); the coordinate event itself is accepted on the base. Moved out of SP-basca7ae by the unattended orchestrator 2026-10-26: builds on ST-hjl7dhyh (backlog.py peers, bl_peers.py), whose gates g1 and g2 (class agents-rule) wait on the operator.
